correctness.rationale: For fixed j, FO theta_j asserts an E-class with exactly j P-points. Its probability is 1−(1−2^(−s_n) binom(s_n,j))^c_n, and because the per-block event probability vanishes, the uniform exponential approximation makes sentence convergence equivalent to an extended limit of λ_n,j. For quantifier rank q, a q-move Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé strategy matches color populations truncated at q within classes and numbers of classes of each profile truncated at q; for s_n>=2q, profiles reduce to 2q minority-color categories and a typical class. Joint rare-category multinomial-to-Poisson convergence and concentration for diverging means give limits for the finite q-profile, hence for every FO sentence. Critical θ_j forces a nontrivial limit, while no critical λ yields a deterministic rank-q profile. The adjacent ratio (s_n−j)/(j+1)→infinity excludes two distinct finite positive means. Inspected verify.py enumerates small colorings and exact profile probabilities; the infinite theorem is the EF + probability argument.
residual_risks: The criterion is restricted to the fair unary-color randomization and to both s_n and c_n diverging; it makes no claim for more expressive logics.
